name: You Shall Not Pass
tagline: A digital lockbox for the Basys 3 FPGA board, written in SystemVerilog.
description: You Shall Not Pass turns a Basys 3 FPGA board into a lockbox. You set a password of three digits from 0 to 7 using three switches, then try to enter it again. Get all three right, in order, and the seven-segment display reads OPEN. Get any wrong and it reads NOPE.

A create switch toggles between two sets of registers: one that stores the password and one that stores your guess. A finite state machine steps through the digits each time you press enter, lighting an LED for each one, and a comparator checks every guess against the stored password.
Built with a partner. The repository includes the SystemVerilog and VHDL source, the Basys 3 constraints file, the block diagrams and the final report.
